mapEditor.title: Map editor

hintDraw.region: Click each corner of the territory on the map. Click the last point again to finish.
hintDraw.road: Click the points of the road on the map. Click the last point again to finish.
hintDraw.stop: Click on the map where the stop is.

mapEditor.hintEdit: Drag vertices to reshape. The small dot between two vertices adds a new one.
mapEditor.hintPlan: Drag the yellow dots to align the image with the map.

invest.title: Investment table

fields.name: Name
fields.priceHint: If left empty, the price is shown as “on request”.

fields.documentsHint: Choose files from the media library.

csv.title: Import from CSV
csv.hint: Upload a file: we check it first, then you confirm the import. Invalid rows are skipped.
csv.columnsHint: Required columns: name, region, category, area, lng, lat. Optional: slug, status, price, publish, name_oz/ru/en, description_*, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email. A row with an existing slug updates that object.
